test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 12 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The Department of Science and Technology (DST) along with Doordarshan, Prasar Bharati announced the launch of two science communication initiatives, DD Science and India Science in January, 2019. Which of the following is correctly explained about these initiatives?

options.text: DD Science is an internet based science channel while India Science is a one-hour slot on Doordarshan National channel.
DD Science is an internet based science channel while India Science is a 24 × 7 on Doordarshan National channel.
DD Science is a one-hour slot on Doordarshan National channel while India Science is an internet based science channel.
DD Science is a 24 × 7 slot on Doordarshan National channel while India Science is an internet based science channel.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 3**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• **DD Science** is a television channel that broadcasts on the Doordarshan National channel for one hour every day. It features a variety of science-related content, including documentaries, discussions, and interviews.
 
• **India Science** is an online science channel that is available 24/7 on the internet. It offers a wider range of content than DD Science, including live streams, scheduled programs, and video-on-demand content.
 
• Both channels are free to access and aim to promote scientific literacy and awareness among the Indian public.

By launching these two channels, the Indian government aims to create a more science-literate society and to encourage young people to pursue careers in science and technology.
